Let me analyze the bug. The rotation matrix from a quaternion q = (a, b, c, d) (with a = scalar part, b,c,d = vector part) is:

R = [[1-2s(c²+d²), 2s(bc - da), 2s(bd + ca)],
     [2s(bc + da), 1-2s(b²+d²), 2s(cd - ba)],
     [2s(bd - ca), 2s(cd + ba), 1-2s(b²+c²)]]

The standard formula (for unit quaternion, active rotation, column-vector convention):

R = [[1-2(y²+z²), 2(xy - wz), 2(xz + wy)],
     [2(xy + wz), 1-2(x²+z²), 2(yz - wx)],
     [2(xz - wy), 2(yz + wx), 1-2(x²+y²)]]

So m12 should be 2*(c*d - b*a), not 2*(c*d + b*a). In the code:

m12 = 2*s*(q.c*q.d + q.b*q.a)  — should be q.c*q.d - q.b*q.a
m21 = 2*s*(q.c*q.d + q.b*q.a)  — this one is correct (yz + wx)
